goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there, I’m thinking about getting some friends together for a meal this weekend—are you any good for a group?
Oh, thanks! There’ll be five of us, and we’re looking forward to catching up somewhere cosy. Would you have space for that size?
We’re planning on Sunday, since everyone’s schedules finally line up for once. Is that a good day for you?
We thought about coming in around 6:30pm, so we could settle in before it gets too late. Does that fit with your dinner service?
Oh, that's perfect—thanks! No allergies or special diets this time, everyone’s pretty easy-going. You can book it under Marcus Bell, please.
Wonderful, thanks so much for sorting that out—I’ll let everyone know. Looking forward to Sunday! [END OF CALL]
